summary:
AlembicAgent rootcause6 downstream integration. Start only from clean AlembicAgent@846e93d39c0e34b501ae4a357aa4d373b15de0d0 and exact local AlembicCore@96655b9bbd56f22381ffa7f48a6cd52cabc5a1da. The controller reproduced the real break: Agent build:check fails because createInductionReceiptV1 now requires currentAnalysisFixpointHash and createFalsificationReceiptV1 requires both currentAnalysisFixpointHash and a real KnowledgeDispositionReviewV1; focused strict tests have 10 failures because old population/review shapes still reach the new Core runtime.

Repair the existing Agent strict production path in place; do not create a parallel analyst/producer platform. Consume semantic authority through the stable @alembic/core/production public facade (host-agent-workflows may remain only for contracts it still legitimately owns). Agent cognition may propose cluster/induction/falsification/expression semantics, but every accepted result must be built from Core canonical facts/execution receipts, complete population denominator rows, exact cluster hash, current analysis review context, independently bound KnowledgeDispositionReviewV1 with canonical hashKnowledgeDispositionProposalV1 semantics, and conserved induction→hypothesis→falsification/disposition→producer eligibility. Remove reviewerReceiptId/string-only authority and old caller-declared structural completion from the strict path. Zero-hypothesis, discard, falsification, producer-non-draft and investigated-empty outcomes must carry the exact Core review/consumer contract; no orphan review may appear. Producer 0/1/N output must expose or derive Core HypothesisExpressionSet terminal closure compatible with the later Main candidate-attempt/admission consumer, without granting Agent persistence, admission, G1/G2, private corpus, or CAS authority.

Preserve the accepted bounded multi-epoch fixpoint and causal repair depth semantics, but rebase their identities on the new Core receipts. Update the curated @alembic/agent/production facade and built-artifact consumer probe only as needed; existing non-strict behavior remains compatible. Add RED→GREEN tests for the controller-reproduced type/runtime failures and negative rebinding/missing-chain/orphan cases. Produce a fresh-process public-facade JSON proof that goes through actual Core canonical constructors rather than handcrafted hashes. Run the evidence contract gates and return one TargetResultEnvelope for controller review only.

Hard boundaries: modify only AlembicAgent; do not edit AlembicCore, Alembic Main, AlembicPlugin, Dashboard, Design, Test, Wakeflow, vendor/gitlinks or caches; do not run real LLMs or touch real data roots; do not claim Main/public bundle/five-tool/Test/demand completion. Main remains blocked until this Agent producer is accepted.
